reviews.Text: I discovered Jacobson’s Oregon sea salt after it was tested by Tamara/LeadSafeMama Labs. Their Oregon salt was the only salt that actually tested low to no lead or other heavy metals. Their Italian salt did not test well. She has recently tested the GREEN box of Maldon, which also tested no lead. We replaced our Celtic salt and pink salts several years ago as a result of them testing high lead and a couple of other metals. Now we only use Jacobson‘s Oregon sourced salt, and have recently added back Maldon’s green box flake salt as well as it is slightly more cost-effective. Jacobson‘s kosher salt is not too large (the one that sold in the canister) and works quite well in our salt grinder. This flake salt is perfect for grilled meats. reviews.Text: We watched a video on YouTube about this company and how they make the salt. They explained just how high quality it is and what it's used for. Now there is a bamboo salt holder on the counter next to the stove. Steak, vegetables, eggs - it all gets a pinch (or more) of the finishing salt just prior to serving - and it is fantastic. One thing to note about this particular finishing salt is the high quality. If you find the video I mentioned, you'll see they put a lot of thought and effort into finding just the right location for the perfect sea water intake to make the salt. It really shows when compared to other similar salts. We purchased a different brand from a local high-end cooking store and the quality didn't come close to this from Jacobson. reviews.OriginDescription: Reviewed in the United States on January 24, 2022
reviews.Text: I never thought I would refer to salt as delicious but here I am! I sprinkle it sparsely and it is extremely flavorful. I had seen a tv program about this salt, featuring the owner and where and how it is collected. It really has the wonderful taste he was trying to achieve. Hand-harvested from pristine American waters.
reviews.Title: This is just delicious!
